text:
Which products are formed when magnesium hydroxide reacts with hydrochloric acid?
A
magnesium chloride, carbon dioxide and water
B
magnesium chloride, hydrogen and water
C
magnesium chloride and hydrogen only
D
magnesium chloride and water only

options.label: A
options.text: magnesium chloride, carbon dioxide and water
